title: Model Routing for AI Agents: Surviving a Provider Outage
excerpt: A dead provider doesn't announce itself; it just stops answering, and a retry loop built for rate limits can make things worse, not better. Here's where a circuit breaker, LiteLLM, and OpenRouter each actually fit.
seo_title: Model Routing for AI Agents: Fallback Guide
meta_description: A practical guide to model routing for AI agents: real circuit-breaker code, LiteLLM Router fallback config, and OpenRouter's routing API, tested live.
social_message:
A provider outage once burned 40 minutes of my agent's retries on a dead endpoint.

I rebuilt the fallback path three ways: a real circuit breaker (tested live), LiteLLM Router's fallback config, and OpenRouter's routing API. One mistake makes the switch invisible until it costs you.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/model-routing-ai-agents/
